title: Dragonwilds’ 2027 Roadmap Could Change the Entire Game
author: SuperStooob
chapters: Blood of Brothers & Priestess of Peril
description:
RuneScape: Dragonwilds’ 2027 roadmap brings four new skills, four quarterly updates and official modding - with Luminance and Prayer arriving first in December 2026.

I spent the weekend at RuneFest, including the developer Q&A. In this breakdown, I cover the announcements, extra Q&A details and what these changes could mean for progression, exploration and reasons to return.

We cover:
• Luminance, Fairy Rings and the Prifddinas-inspired building kit
• Prayer and the balance of protection effects
• Hunter, Slayer level requirements and two unnamed 2027 skills
• Song of Rebellion, Blood of Brothers, Priestess of Peril and Crown of Night
• The Dark Bow, Ivandis Flail and possible RuneScape connections
• Official CurseForge modding, storage discussions and developer interest in photo mode
• How the RS4 announcement changes the context of the older roadmap

0:00 The Dragonwilds 2027 Roadmap
1:11 Luminance, Fairy Rings & Elven Building
2:48 Prayer & Protection Concerns
4:13 Song of Rebellion & Hunter
5:56 Slayer Level Requirements
7:28 Dark Beasts & Dark Bow Theory
8:41 Blood of Brothers & Priestess of Peril
9:37 Crown of Night & Legendary Weapons
10:55 Inventory & Storage Changes
12:10 Official Modding & Photo Mode Discussion
13:13 RS4 & Dragonwilds’ Future

The Barrows and dark beast connections are discussed as theories based on public announcements. Specific monsters, skill requirements and release dates beyond those announced remain unconfirmed.

Would you support Slayer requirements on existing enemies if you kept the gear you’d already earned? Let me know below.

Subscribe for more RuneScape: Dragonwilds guides, updates and challenges.
